changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Releases up to 1.0.0-rc.8 stored a capture refusal as readiness_refused on the practice of a review and on its memberships. Later releases store READINESS_REFUSED, and nothing writes the old spelling again. These rows get the one spelling.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE review_practice SET reason = 'READINESS_REFUSED' WHERE reason = 'readiness_refused'; UPDATE review_item SET reason = 'READINESS_REFUSED' WHERE reason = 'readiness_refused';

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup to get the old spelling back. Releases from 1.0.0-rc.9 on read READINESS_REFUSED, so a downgrade to one of them needs no rollback.
